headline: Cost Pressure and Lower Occupancy Drag Premium Margin

highlights: TRevPAR stood at INR 23,264 (+18% YoY). ▪ Revenue grew 12.6% YoY to INR 5.5 Bn (beating CIE estimate of INR 5.1 Bn by 7.7%). ▪ EBITDA margin came in at 38.2% (-52 bps YoY, beating CIE estimate of 35.6%) at INR 2.1 Bn (+11.1% YoY). ▪ PAT came in at INR 337 Mn (beating CIE estimate of INR 276 Mn by 22.3%) driven by higher margin and better occupancy as compared to our estimate.
The decline in PAT was attributed to higher depreciation on hotel assets and lower other income on a high forex-gain base.

Debt-funded Expansion Gathers Pace; FY28E Openings in Sight Gross borrowing| rose to INR 23.7 Bn (from INR 20.3 Bn in March-26), funding the ~INR-2.8 Bn Kelzai acquisition, lifting Net Debt/EBITDA to 1.6x (from 1.2x).
We expect elevated D&A and interest to cap near- term PAT growth, with deleveraging and earnings recovery as new keys ramp up from FY29.
valuation: View and Valuation We revise our estimate downward to reflect the new normal of higher diesel cost and inflationary pressure.
